Alex (Support): FYI customer reported a production incident — tool-call failing intermittently with schema validation errors and huge token billing spikes. See logs attached from their request.

deploy-bot: Alert: 1954326789 - tool_invocation_error - customer: acme-inc - rate: high - severity: P2 :rotating_light:

Alex (Support): Error in logs: `400 - tool_schema_mismatch - expected field 'query' string, got object` and downstream we see router selected `semantic-search-v2` while customer payload was for `vector-search-legacy`. Billing note: cost spiked because v2 triggered long reranks.

Maria (Eng): @Priya can you share the router decision trace? I want to see why it matched v2. Also need a minimal repro request from the customer.

Priya (Oncall): Repro request from customer (redacted):
```json
{ "model": "redwood-chat-2", "tool": "search", "input": { "query": { "text": "price list" }, "filters": ["region:us"] }, "call_preference": "fast" }
```
Router trace shows: `route_key=search, candidate_variants=[semantic-search-v2 (score 0.87), vector-search-legacy (score 0.83)]`, policy=auto-select by variant_score, selected=semantic-search-v2.

Jordan (SRE): The issue is v2 expects `query` as a string, but the legacy path supported nested `query.text`. When the runtime marshals args for v2 it flattens and ends up sending `{"query": {"text":"..."}}` which fails validation and triggers a fallback loop that retries with increasing token budgets -> billing spike.

Alex (Support): Customer shows `400` and we see 3 retries in logs: timestamps 1954326701, 1954326714, 1954326730. Each retry invoked v2 with different batch context, causing 3x token usage.

Maria (Eng): Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) Hotfix router to prefer exact-signature matching before variant_score (toggle feature flag rtr.strict_sig_match = true). 2) Add quick validation shim on router to normalize legacy nested `query` -> string for v2. 3) Rollback semantic-search-v2 for this customer until we deploy patch.

Priya (Oncall): I applied route override for acme-inc: `route_override.acme-inc = vector-search-legacy` at 1954326920. Confirmed no more v2 selections after that.

Jordan (SRE): Quick repro command for engineers:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${API_KEY}"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-2","tool":"search","input":{"query":{"text":"pricing"},"filters":["region:us"]},"call_preference":"fast"}'
```
Expected: vector-search-legacy chosen or router normalizes payload. Observed: semantic-search-v2 chosen -> 400 with body `{"error":"tool_schema_mismatch","details":"expected string for 'query'"}`.

Maria (Eng): Root cause analysis notes: variant selection uses embeddings+sig heuristics; scoring occasionally prefers newer variants even when input shape mismatches. We'll push a rule to include an `input_shape_score` and fail candidate if mismatch.

Alex (Support): Customer impact: several failed calls and ~3x token billing on ~500 calls over a 10-minute window. They've requested a credit and a permanent fix.

Jordan (SRE): Actions done: - override for acme-inc applied - egress throttling on v2 for 10m to stop retries - created ticket INF-2143 for router signature-matching change - scheduled a patch to add quick normalization shim (Marina assigned).

Priya (Oncall): Customer updated: they confirmed success after override and asked for billing credit. I've escalated to billing ops with invoice refs.

Maria (Eng): Next steps: implement strict_sig_match feature flag by EOD, ship normalization shim in next deploy, add a unit test that simulates nested vs flattened `query` shapes. Also add telemetry to surface shape mismatches in the console.

Alex (Support): Thanks team. I'll keep the thread updated with customer correspondence and billing outcome. :white_check_mark:
